content:
[Verse 1]
[C#m]How dare you say that my be-
havior is [G#]unacceptable
[C#m]So condescending unne-
[G#]cessarily critical
[C#m]I have the tendency of
getting very [G#]physical
[C#m]So watch your step cause if I
do you'll need [G#]a miracle
[C#m]You drain me dry and make me
wonder why I'm [G#]even here
[C#m]The double vision I was
seeing is [G#]finally clear
[C#m]You want to stay but you know
very well I [G#]want you gone
[C#m]Not fit to fuckin' tread the
ground that I am walking on

[Chorus]
But when it gets [G#]cold
outside and you got
[Bm]nobody to [F#]love
[C#m]You'll understand what I [G#]mean
when I say There's no way
[Bm]we're gonna give [F#]up
[C#m]And like a little girl [G#]cries
in the face of a mon-
[Bm]ster that lives in her [F#]dreams
[C#m]Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-
der and harder to breathe
Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-
der and harder to breathe
[D5]

[Verse 2]
[C#m]What you are doing is scre-
wing things up [G#]inside my head
[C#m]You should know better you ne-
ver listened to [G#]a word I said
[C#m]Clutching your pillow and wri-
thing in a [G#]naked sweat
[C#m]Hoping somebody someday
will do you like I did

[Chorus]
But when it gets [G#]cold
outside and you got
[Bm]nobody to [F#]love
[C#m]You'll understand what I [G#]mean
when I say There's no way
[Bm]we're gonna give [F#]up
[C#m]And like a little girl [G#]cries
in the face of a mon-
[Bm]ster that lives in her [F#]dreams
[C#m]Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-
[G#]der and harder to [C#m]breathe
Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-
der and harder to breathe

[Solo]
[C#m]
Does it kill
Does it burn Is it pain-
ful to learn That it's me
that has all the control
Does it thrill
Does it sting When you feel
what I bring And you wish
that you had me to hold

[Chorus]
But when it gets [G#]cold
outside and you got
[Bm]nobody to [F#]love
[C#m]You'll understand what I [G#]mean
when I say There's no way
[Bm]we're gonna give [F#]up
[C#m]And like a little girl [G#]cries
in the face of a mon-
[Bm]ster that lives in her [F#]dreams
[C#m]Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-
[G#]der and harder to [C#m]breathe

[Outro]
Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-
der and harder to breathe
Is there anyone out
there cause it's getting har-

title: Harder to Breathe
